params.body:
Four days of production log counted **415 messages to Doorlinken Voorraad, 189 of them unique**:
54 per cent was a repeat of something already sent, and one vehicle got the same `update` twelve
times. Nothing was wrong with those vehicles — a sheet is simply saved several times on a working
day, and every save that counted as a change rang the partners.

**The rule, decided today:** a partner hears about a vehicle when something in the message changed.

Every successful delivery now carries the fingerprint of what was in it
(`webhook_deliveries.payload_hash`), and a message that is word for word the same as the last one
that *arrived* at that receiver, about that vehicle, of that kind, does not leave.

**Three things always go**, and each for its own reason:

- `sold` and `delete` are events, not a description of a vehicle. A receiver may never miss one,
  even when the body is identical to the last.
- A delivery that failed leaves nothing to compare against, so a retry goes out as before.
- A vehicle with no successful fingerprinted delivery (every row from before this change) says
  nothing about what was in it.

**What was deliberately not built**, because it was the obvious alternative: coalescing everything
inside a five-minute window. That delays the one change that is actually in a hurry — a price coming
down — and the window would be a number nobody can defend. Comparing what we send is something you
can explain to a partner in one sentence.

**And an answer to the question that came with it:** no, a sold vehicle does not keep calling. Only
the *transition* to sold rings the partners once, and after that the vehicle drops out of every
other branch — no `update`, no Nederland Mobiel, no export mail. That was already right (finding
X-97 fixed it), because those three fields stay filled forever and every later save used to send
`sold` again.

R S2-10.12 is new and says all of this. Four tests, each checked by taking the guard out again.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: A partner hears about a vehicle when something in the message changed
